answer_1.quote: we adopt a method that first performs image captioning, edits the caption for cultural relevance using an LLM
answer_1.outputs: Textual captions and culturally edited captions

answer_2.quote: Following suit, we calculate two metrics: a) image-similarity: we embed the original image and each of the generated images using DiNO-ViT and measure cosine similarity b) country-relevance: we embed the text -This image is culturally relevant to {COUNTRY}, and the edited images using CLIP and calculate their cosine similarity.

answer_4.quote: In §4, we conduct human evaluation of images transcreated for both concept and application, across all seven countries.
answer_4.guideline: The questionnaire includes questions such as C0 (visual change), C1 (semantic equivalence), C2 (spatial layout), C3 (cultural relevance), C4 (naturalness), C5 (offensiveness), E/S1 (education task or story-text match), and E/S2 (cultural relevance for application).
